name: Interview Prep Roadmap
description: A structured plan targeting coding interviews. Covers the core patterns interviewers love and how to communicate your reasoning clearly while solving.
milestones: Sliding window problems for substring and subarray questions.
Two pointers for sorted arrays and in-place manipulation.
Fast and slow pointers for cycles and linked list structure.
Backtracking for combinations, permutations, and subsets.
Graph traversal — BFS, DFS, topological sort, Dijkstra.
Mock interviews with a timer and narrated thinking.
recommended_problems: Kth Largest Element in an Array
study_plan: Week 5-6: mixed mock interviews, timing every session.
tips: Narrate your thought process — interviewers grade communication.
Always state time and space complexity before writing code.
Brush up on at least one language's built-in data structures.
